wiki.summary: “cigarette smoke” is the closing track to Olivia’s third album, you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love. In the song she refers to her ex as “cigarette smoke”, which is smell that is hard to get rid of, as it is hard to forget her ex, Olivia regrets ever having a relationship with her ex. and hates how cowardly her ex acted. Read more on Last.fm.
